taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: compact rounded shrub 3-10 dm. high.

traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: 3-10 dm. high: 1 m at most.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: a shrub.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: compact rounded shrub, resinous.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: evergreen: the resinous linear leaves stay on through the year, as on its relatives in the genus.

traits.rosette.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: leafy branches, no rosette.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Leaves crowded and alternate along the twigs, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 105162415, 80050961, 154581701, 12441625, 269893975, 104821011, 107501397, 79883771): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: leaves linear, entire: simple.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: leaves linear, entire.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: leaves linear, 1-2 cm. long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: leaves 1-2 mm. wide; Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 904) key it by leaves not more than 2 mm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: leaves linear.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: leaves linear, entire.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: glabrous, resinous and glandular-punctate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: heads in small leafy cymes at the ends of the branches.

traits.inflorescence_unit.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: heads (capitula) in small cymes.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: cymes 2 cm to 5 cm across, as in the photos.

traits.capitulum_kind.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 904), Haplopappus laricifolius: heads radiate; Abrams and Ferris (1960, p. 288) give rays 3-11.

traits.involucre_height_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: involucre 3-5 mm. high.

traits.ray_florets.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: rays 3-11.

traits.disc_florets.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960) p. 288, Ericameria laricifolia: disk-flowers 10-16.

traits.ray_colour.note: Rays golden yellow; sRGB by eye, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 105162415, 80050961, 154581701, 12441625, 269893975, 104821011, 107501397, 79883771): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.disc_colour.note: Disc yellow; sRGB by eye, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 105162415, 80050961, 154581701, 12441625, 269893975, 104821011, 107501397, 79883771): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.fruit_type.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a cypsela with a pappus of bristles, as in the genus.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: cypselae 3 mm to 4 mm long.

traits.flowering_months.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 906), Haplopappus laricifolius: 3,000 to 6,000 feet, August to November (Abrams and Ferris 1960 p. 288: September and October).

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: cypselae shed from October to December, after the autumn flowering.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 906), Haplopappus laricifolius: 3,000 to 6,000 feet: about 900 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 906), Haplopappus laricifolius: 3,000 to 6,000 feet: about 1,830 m.

traits.light.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 906), Haplopappus laricifolius: dry rocky slopes and mesas: open, sunny ground.

traits.moisture.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 906), Haplopappus laricifolius: dry rocky slopes and mesas.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a compact rounded shrub of many upright stems, bright green needle-like leaves crowded on the twigs, flat clusters of small golden heads in autumn that fade to buff.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for turpentine bush from its sources and the photos the traits cite, on the template of rubber rabbitbrush (ericameria-nauseosa); the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.6 m tall at 10 years in the open, within its sources' range, as it grows on a Sonoran Desert bajada. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added for the Saguaro desert scene (west bajada, Tucson Mountain District, 2026-10-19): sizes and forms from FEIS, Kearney and Peebles (1942) and Abrams, counts and colours from iNaturalist photos, drawing values from the library's rules for the form.
